rationale: The signal establishes minimality for the recorded exit flag, but does not establish that {a,b} reproduces F. Moreover, test-relative minimality would not establish that a and b are F’s unique underlying root cause.

signal_basis.exact_text: Subset {a,b} produces that flag on every replay; {a} and {b} do not.
Thus both flag values occur with or without F. No target-F trace or result is recorded for any reduced subset; the flag is not a timing bound.
A retained minimal configuration demonstrates reproducibility under the test, not necessarily the unique underlying causal mechanism.
